create_DirectoryReader: create a DirectoryReader instance to read files from an unzipped PyTorch package directory
test_DirectoryReader_get_record: test the DirectoryReader get_record method to read binary data from a file in the package directory
test_DirectoryReader_get_storage_from_re: test the DirectoryReader get_storage_from_record method to load a torch.UntypedStorage from a file
test_DirectoryReader_has_record: test the DirectoryReader has_record method to check if a file exists in the package directory
test_DirectoryReader_get_all_records: test the DirectoryReader get_all_records method to list all files recursively in the package directory
